authentication_checks.detail: REPORT INTEGRATION ALLOWED WITH REQUIRED LIMITATIONS

determinism: fixed ordering, seeds, plot style, PDF metadata, CSV float format, and LF newlines

figure_records.interpretation: Performance varies by dataset and model; unavailable cells remain grey crosses.
figure_records.limitation: Point estimates do not establish superiority.
figure_records.population: 66 primary-cohort registered cells across three locked OOT populations: 54 numeric, 12 unavailable
figure_records.title: Locked OOT ROC-AUC by registered cell
figure_records.uncertainty: Intervals absent unless registered in the comparison table

figure_records.limitation: DEV folds are not independent datasets.
figure_records.population: 124 identities with numeric DEV means; locked OOT populations n=120,053, 293,105, and 304,916
figure_records.title: DEV mean versus locked OOT ROC-AUC
figure_records.uncertainty: DEV fold SD is tabulated, not used as OOT uncertainty

figure_records.limitation: Missing cells are NA, not zero.
figure_records.title: Locked OOT minus DEV mean AUC

figure_records.limitation: Maximum KS is threshold-free in value; operational metrics use the frozen threshold.
figure_records.title: Locked OOT maximum KS
figure_records.uncertainty: None; frozen decision thresholds are in the companion table

figure_records.interpretation: Effects include positive, negative, and inconclusive evidence.
figure_records.limitation: Original two-dataset rows are low-power fold diagnostics, not OOT inference.
figure_records.title: LLM-assisted effect versus matching mRMR
figure_records.uncertainty: 95% paired bootstrap intervals only where registered; Holm marker

figure_records.interpretation: Non-significance is common and is not equivalence.
figure_records.limitation: NA is unavailable, never p=1 or zero effect.
figure_records.title: Holm-adjusted significance

figure_records.limitation: 0.10/0.25 bands are not drawn because their role differs across cohorts.
figure_records.population: 54 cells with authenticated DEV OOF and OOT score PSI
figure_records.title: DEV-referenced OOT score PSI

figure_records.interpretation: Predictor drift need not align with AUC change.
figure_records.limitation: Feature universes differ; compare within dataset.
figure_records.title: Type-aware selected-feature PSI

figure_records.interpretation: Stable selection is distinct from predictive performance.
figure_records.limitation: Only available fold sets enter each summary.
figure_records.population: 58 method/model summaries with authenticated fold selection sets
figure_records.title: Fold selection stability

figure_records.population: 456 within-dataset/model pairwise final-selection records; figure shows the protocol-fixed LR subset
figure_records.title: Within-dataset method overlap

figure_records.interpretation: LLM/hybrid resource cost is not uniform.
figure_records.limitation: Per-cell RAM is unavailable for some cohorts; crosses are NA.
figure_records.title: Runtime and peak RAM

figure_records.interpretation: Trade-offs, not a universal winner, are visible.
figure_records.title: Performance versus runtime

figure_records.limitation: Third benchmark shares Home Credit lineage.
figure_records.population: 12 registered LLM/stable-core versus matching mRMR identities (12 numeric)
figure_records.title: LLM incremental AUC

figure_records.limitation: Ranks omit methods without common coverage and are descriptive.
figure_records.population: Up to 18 common method/dataset/model identities: mRMR, LLM, and stable-core
figure_records.title: Cross-dataset common-method ranks

figure_records.interpretation: Curve shape supports the tabulated AUC evidence.
figure_records.limitation: Subset fixed by method role, not observed performance.
figure_records.population: 18 saved-prediction curves over locked OOT populations n=120,053, 293,105, and 304,916
figure_records.title: Protocol-fixed OOT ROC curves

figure_records.population: Same 18 saved-prediction curves; ten quantile bins per curve
figure_records.title: Protocol-fixed OOT calibration

figure_records.interpretation: Methods differ in score spread and location.
figure_records.limitation: Density shape is not a performance test.
figure_records.population: Same 18 saved-prediction curves across three locked OOT populations
figure_records.title: Protocol-fixed OOT score distributions
